portInfo.description: Plymouth splits cruise landings between Associated British Ports’ Millbay Docks passenger terminal (West Wharf and Trinity Pier limits above) and the Barbican Landing Stage, a Cattewater Harbour Commissioners tender pontoon used from a sheltered anchorage inside the Plymouth Breakwater. Destination Plymouth’s trade berthing page is the source for LOA/draft, tender time and Millbay terminal amenities (check-in desks, lounge, ISPS screening). Confirm which model your line uses before planning walk times — tender and Millbay are different start points.
